title: Show HN: Leaves – A text-UI disk usage treemap visualizer
rss_summary:
GUI disk analyzers are great for figuring out what's filling up your laptop/desktop drive.On containers or remote servers, the options are limited to purely text based
utilities (e.g. du) or list-centric TUIs (e.g. ncdu) which are usually limited
to viewing one directory at a time.I created leaves to fill that gap.Inspired by classic utilities like WinDirStat and KDirStat, it uses a
2-dimensional treemap^1 visualization to show the entire directory hierarchy
with proportionally sized rectangles.
